title: Grimm's Mod Base
description: Base mod for the Grimm's modernized series, now including lattes (?). General content expansion and adventure mod.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4c2121e0bcdeada9da9c10b7965fea328ddd1e6.png)
### What is this mod and what does it do?
This is the base mod for the New Grimm's Mod™ adding items and utilities used by the other mods in the series that require it. What does it add? Ores, items and tags for mods to use.

The full feature list for all versions is right here: [Version List](https://workflowy.com/s/grimms-mod-base-sat/RkcSsknuMXjudOsX)

The list of mods in the series as of now: [Grimm's Mod™ Series](https://modrinth.com/collection/7UbwSiHh)
